_note: Azerbaijani. Written separately from Turkish, because the diff said to: over all
134 words x 3 prose fields, tr and az share ZERO identical cells. The 0.63 mean
similarity is the two languages being close, not the two files agreeing - the
bg/mk lesson, and the reason the Chinese trick does not transfer here.
Writing it beside the finished Turkish is a hazard rather than a help, and the
shipped file already showed why: the trenchant line read 'Laf kalabaligini kesir',
which is Turkish, not Azerbaijani. That is the nb-was-Danish and af-was-Dutch
fault a third time - a locale written next to its big sibling drifts into the
sibling, and no check in this project can see it, because the drifted phrase is
real words in the other language. It is 'Soz yiginini kesir' now.
The seven specimen quotations stay English. Reported speech is Azerbaijani, as it
already was: 'gelin ve goturun', 'mukemmel zovqumu', 'Dostlugun heqiqi menasi'.
'Doomscrolling' stays because it IS the specimen of a new coinage, and 'who' /
'whom' stays because it is an English distinction Azerbaijani does not have.
english_ok is mathesis alone. Elsewhere the plainer Azerbaijani word was reached
for first: soporific to yuxugetirici, plumb-line to saqul, seneschal to mulk
mudiri, canaille to ayaqtakimi, anchorite to zahid.
Four spelling faults in the shipped rows were repaired in passing, all of them
invisible to every sweep here: muvekkil for muvekkil, tedirgin for tedirgin,
'Nahar derhal sonra' for 'Nahardan derhal sonra', and 'fricasseed toyuq' for
'toyugu', which wanted the possessive.
